g.text: M2: execution participation and service outcomes at natural capacity
Bars: two-run means; dots: individual restarts. Compare modes within each workload, not shapes with different output work.
Unselected does not mean wasted GPU time or avoidable loss. Overlap and normal scheduling can contribute to this proxy.
